$comment: Owner-accepted exceptions to CI's full-tree npm audit, read by scripts/audit-check.mjs. Each entry waives ONE advisory in ONE package, at no more than its accepted 'severity' ('high' or 'critical'), for development dependencies only, until its 'expires' date (inclusive, UTC; at most 90 days after 'acceptedOn'). The check still fails if a listed advisory reaches production dependencies or is re-rated above its accepted severity. Policy, renewal and removal: docs/security-day-1.md.
